mobbin:9589355a-7154-4414-84ca-0228270aa.summary: On a call review, the user reads the AI recap, picks a summary length, waits while it regenerates, and gets a longer recap that can still be shared.
steps: Call Review: Recap and timestamped Comments
Recap tools: edit, 'Copy', thumbs beside player
Choose a summary length: Short, Medium, Long, Bulleted
Recap: Please wait while formatted summary generates
Regenerated Recap: longer narrative plus share link
steal: A length menu (Short, Medium, Long, Bulleted) regenerates the recap in place with one control (screens 3 to 5).
A wait message on the recap while it reformats shows that the change is in progress (screen 4).
Time-stamped comments with @mentions next to the recap let faculty add notes to the same session report (screens 1 to 2).
'Copy link' and 'Share' in the call review header make sharing by link the default (screens 1 and 5).
avoid: An empty Moments column with nothing to do should be hidden or explained until there are highlights (screens 1 to 5).
mobbin:9589355a-7154-4414-84ca-0228270aa.fit: Reports: an AI session recap with a length control and link sharing. It fits formative summaries for faculty or deans, not tables of room-use numbers.
